settings.heading: Curation as a small, repeated kindness
settings.body:
The Monthly Edit started with a simple observation: the things that lift an ordinary day are rarely expensive, but they are easy to forget to buy.

So we do the remembering. Every edition is assembled by hand from makers we have met, tasted and tested, then sent on a rhythm you choose. No noise, no hard sell, just something lovely arriving when it should.
